description: This file defines a React-like component called 'Header' using the Lightning.js framework. It includes a template for rendering header UI elements, manages state related to theme colors, and handles user events to trigger a callback for creating new notes.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: A component representing the header section of the application, with title and New Note button, handling click events to trigger provided callbacks.

methods.name: input.enter
methods.description: Handler for the enter input event, triggers the onNew callback if provided.

methods.name: click.handler
methods.description: Handler for click events, triggers the onNew callback if provided.
